\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{ইস্তফা} (istôphā)}{ইস্তফা (istôphā)}]{\bn{ইস্তফা} (istôphā) — a resignation}

\label{lesson:BN-C497-istopha}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for senior in rank, then the Bengali for to stay in post.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{ইস্তফা}}
\textbf{\bn{ইস্তফা}} — \emph{istôphā} — \textquotedblleft{}a resignation\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{মামা} \bn{চাকরি} \bn{থেকে} \bn{ইস্তফা} \bn{দিলেন।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Māmā chākri theke istôphā dilen.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
My uncle resigned from his job.
\end{quote}

With \bn{দেওয়া}: \bn{ইস্তফা} \bn{দেওয়া}, to resign.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{ইস্তফা}} (\emph{istôphā}) is usually traced to Arabic \emph{istiʿfā}, \textquotedblleft{}asking to be let off\textquotedblright{}, which reached Bengali through Persian.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{istôphā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{istôphā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Māmā chākri theke istôphā dilen.} — My uncle resigned from his job.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for senior in rank, then the Bengali for to stay in post, then say \emph{istôphā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{ইস্তফা} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A resignation\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{বদলি} (bôdli)}{বদলি (bôdli)}]{\bn{বদলি} (bôdli) — a job transfer; a transfer to another place}

\label{lesson:BN-C497-bodli}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to stay in post, then the Bengali for a resignation.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{বদলি}}
\textbf{\bn{বদলি}} — \emph{bôdli} — \textquotedblleft{}a job transfer; a transfer to another place\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{বাবার} \bn{নতুন} \bn{শহরে} \bn{বদলি} \bn{হল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Bābār nôtun shôhôre bôdli hôlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
My father was transferred to a new city.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{বদলি}} (\emph{bôdli}) is usually traced to Arabic \emph{badal}, \textquotedblleft{}exchange, a substitute\textquotedblright{}, through Persian: one post given in exchange for another.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bôdli}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bôdli}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Bābār nôtun shôhôre bôdli hôlô.} — My father was transferred to a new city.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to stay in post, then the Bengali for a resignation, then say \emph{bôdli} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{বদলি} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A job transfer; a transfer to another place\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{ধর্মঘট} (dhôrmôghôṭ)}{ধর্মঘট (dhôrmôghôṭ)}]{\bn{ধর্মঘট} (dhôrmôghôṭ) — a strike by workers}

\label{lesson:BN-C497-dhormoghot}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a resignation, then the Bengali for a job transfer.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{ধর্মঘট}}
\textbf{\bn{ধর্মঘট}} — \emph{dhôrmôghôṭ} — \textquotedblleft{}a strike by workers\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আজ} \bn{বাসের} \bn{ধর্মঘট}, \bn{তাই} \bn{আমি} \bn{হেঁটে} \bn{অফিসে} \bn{গেলাম।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Āj bāser dhôrmôghôṭ, tāi āmi hẽṭe ôphise gelām.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
There's a bus strike today, so I walked to the office.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{ধর্মঘট}} (\emph{dhôrmôghôṭ}) joins Sanskrit \emph{dharma}, \textquotedblleft{}what is established, duty\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams), and \emph{ghaṭa}, \textquotedblleft{}a water pot\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 4406); how the pair came to mean a strike is not settled.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{dhôrmôghôṭ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{dhôrmôghôṭ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Āj bāser dhôrmôghôṭ, tāi āmi hẽṭe ôphise gelām.} — There's a bus strike today, so I walked to the office.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a resignation, then the Bengali for a job transfer, then say \emph{dhôrmôghôṭ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{ধর্মঘট} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A strike by workers\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{বরখাস্ত} (bôrkhāstô)}{বরখাস্ত (bôrkhāstô)}]{\bn{বরখাস্ত} (bôrkhāstô) — dismissed (from a job)}

\label{lesson:BN-C497-borkhasto}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a job transfer, then the Bengali for a strike by workers.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{বরখাস্ত}}
\textbf{\bn{বরখাস্ত}} — \emph{bôrkhāstô} — \textquotedblleft{}dismissed (from a job)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{কোম্পানি} \bn{চোরটাকে} \bn{বরখাস্ত} \bn{করল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Kompāni chorṭāke bôrkhāstô kôrlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The company dismissed the thief.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{বরখাস্ত}} (\emph{bôrkhāstô}) is usually traced to Persian \emph{barkhāst}, \textquotedblleft{}risen up, done away with\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bôrkhāstô}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Kompāni chorṭāke bôrkhāstô kôrlô.} — The company dismissed the thief.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a job transfer, then the Bengali for a strike by workers, then say \emph{bôrkhāstô} again

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{ছাঁটাই} \bn{করা} (chhā̃ṭāi kôrā)}{ছাঁটাই করা (chhā̃ṭāi kôrā)}]{\bn{ছাঁটাই} \bn{করা} (chhā̃ṭāi kôrā) — to lay off (workers)}

\label{lesson:BN-C497-chhatai-kora}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a strike by workers, then the Bengali for dismissed.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{ছাঁটাই} \bn{করা}}
\textbf{\bn{ছাঁটাই} \bn{করা}} — \emph{chhā̃ṭāi kôrā} — \textquotedblleft{}to lay off (workers)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{কারখানাটা} \bn{পঞ্চাশজন} \bn{মজুর} \bn{ছাঁটাই} \bn{করল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Kārkhānāṭā pônchāshjôn mojur chhā̃ṭāi kôrlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The factory laid off fifty labourers.
\end{quote}

Past (he/she …): \bn{তিনি} \bn{দশজন} \bn{কর্মী} \bn{ছাঁটাই} \bn{করলেন}, \emph{tini dôshjôn kôrmī chhā̃ṭāi kôrlen}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{ছাঁটাই} \bn{করা}} (\emph{chhā̃ṭāi kôrā}) joins \bn{ছাঁটাই}, \textquotedblleft{}a cutting back\textquotedblright{}, built on \bn{ছাঁটা}, \textquotedblleft{}to trim\textquotedblright{}, to \bn{করা}, \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{}; CDIAL lists Bengali \emph{chā̃ṭā}, \textquotedblleft{}to lop\textquotedblright{}, under a reconstructed \emph{chāṇṭ}, \textquotedblleft{}cut\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 5013). Of workers it means to lay them off.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{chhā̃ṭāi kôrā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Kārkhānāṭā pônchāshjôn mojur chhā̃ṭāi kôrlô.} — The factory laid off fifty labourers.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a strike by workers, then the Bengali for dismissed, then say \emph{chhā̃ṭāi kôrā} again
